title: UDPConfiguration
description: UDPConfiguration contains all the UDP configuration parameters.

entryPoints.description: EntryPoints defines the list of entry point names to bind to. Entry points have to be configured in the static configuration. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/install-configuration/entrypoints/ Default: all.

service.description: Service defines the reference to a Kubernetes Service that will serve the error page. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/http/middlewares/errorpages/#service

services.description: Services defines the list of Kubernetes Service and/or TraefikService to load-balance, with weight.

address.description: Address defines the authentication server address.

weighted.description: Weighted defines the Weighted Round Robin configuration.

services.description: Services defines the list of Kubernetes Service and/or TraefikService to load-balance, with weight.

name.description: Name defines the name of the referenced IngressRoute resource.

weight.description: Weight defines the weight and should only be specified when Name references a TraefikService object (and to be precise, one that embeds a Weighted Round Robin).
